subject: cassette with tape-curl hair
art_direction: 磁带壳角色把松开的磁带当卷发，芥黄与黑色三色平面，叉腰神态欠欠的。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Make a cassette tape character with a broad rectangular body softened at the corners. A single loop of loose magnetic tape rises above it as an unruly curl, while two short arms and shoe-like feet provide attitude. One hand rests on its side, and the body leans as if delivering a dry joke. Keep the reel windows as mechanical details rather than giant eyes; place a small asymmetrical face between them. Use mustard, black, and cream screenprint shapes with no labels, writing, gradients, or background objects. Square 1024x1024. Keep the complete central silhouette within a circular crop, occupying about 70% of the canvas. Original design; no lettering, logos, or watermark.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
visual_review: passed: compressed preview inspected for distinct original concept, appealing silhouette and expression, requested medium, coherent shape/anatomy, clean visual hierarchy, no text or watermark
